name: Blue Ocean Strategy Canvas & ERRC Grid
diagnostic: Which category conventions can we discard, which must we reduce below standard, and which neglected factors should we elevate to break industry trade-offs?
artifact: A Strategic Value Curve Chart paired with an Eliminate-Reduce-Raise-Create (ERRC) Operational Matrix mapping asymmetric investment against industry benchmarks.
trap: Benchmark convergence: competing on every established axis drives up marginal cost and ends in commoditization.
pedigreeFull: W. Chan Kim & Renée Mauborgne (*Blue Ocean Strategy*, 2005; INSEAD). An analytical framework designed to break the structural trade-off between differentiation and low cost by reconstructing buyer value curves.
artifactFull: A Strategic Value Curve Chart paired with an Eliminate-Reduce-Raise-Create (ERRC) Operational Matrix mapping asymmetric investment against industry benchmarks.
trapFull: Engaging in benchmark convergence—competing simultaneously on every established feature axis, which drives up marginal costs and degrades into a race toward commoditization.
